To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

physical exercise in rats with diet-induced obesity, both acute and long term, improves insulin signaling in the liver, skeletal muscle, and adipocytes, which is accompanied by a reduction in circulating lipopolysac-charides and a reduction in TLR4 activation and expression in the liver, adipose tissue, and skeletal muscle.
physical exercise reduces circulating LPS and TLR4 signaling and improves insulin signaling in tissues of obese animals.
exercise in obese rats reduces TLR4 expression, LPS serum levels and TLR4 signaling, and improves insulin sensitivity and insulin signaling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular basis of the anti-inflammatory effect of exercise in obesity.
the effects of exercise on the TLR4 pathway and its consequences on inflammation and insulin sensitivity.
the molecular mechanisms involved in the beneficial effects of physical exercise on insulin resistance in obesity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
exercise improves insulin sensitivity in obese rats, in part, via a suppression of the TLR4 pathway.
physical exercise reduces the circulating LPS levels and the activation of TLR4 and its downstream signaling in tissues of DFO rats, improving insulin sensitivity.
exercise improves insulin signaling, sensitivity, and inflammation in DIO rats by reducing TLR4 activation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chronic and acute exercise reduced TLR-4 expression and activation and improved insulin signaling in tissues of DFO rats.
exercise reduces circulating LPS and improves insulin signaling in the tissues of obese rats, and this effect is mediated by a reduction in TLR4 activation.
physical exercise reduces TLR4 activation in tissues, and, consequently, improves insulin signaling and insulin sensitivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that

exercise reduces circulating LPS and TLR4 activation and improves insulin signaling in tissues of D IO rats, suggesting that exercise could be a useful tool in the prevention and treatment of insulin resistance and diabetes.
physical exercise is a potent anti-inflammatory strategy in obesity and insulin resistance.
exercise can be considered as a therapeutic strategy to treat insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.
